newsitem.title: UK: Atkins wins contract for giant LG plant.
newsitem.headline: Atkins wins contract for giant LG plant.

text.p: British construction and technology consultancy WS Atkins said on Monday it had won a contract to project manage the first phase of a new electronics plant in Wales for LG Electronics of South Korea.
In a statement, which gave no financial details of the contract, Atkins said it had won the work after visiting LG Electronics plants in Korea and Indonesia.
The company's shares, which have risen strongly in recent weeks, added 17 pence during the morning to stand at 339 1/2p by 0940 GMT.
Last Monday Atkins announced it had won what it called a "breakthrough" contract for work on a proposed rail project in Hong Kong for the Kowloon Canton Railway Corporation.
